page.overview:
Who is Goha Monsters?

The Goha Monsters, known as the Goha Astro Monsters in the Japanese version, are Goha City's professional baseball team in the Yu-Gi-Oh! SEVENS anime. They are owned by Yuka Goha, who stated that any president should own a baseball team. During tryouts for the team at the Goha Baseball Stadium, Yuka Rush Dueled Romin Kassidy.
